# English maintenance instructions

The engineering team reviews the service dashboard every morning before opening the production workspace. Each operator checks the sensor readings, records unusual temperatures, and compares the current measurements with the previous weekly report. If an alert appears, the operator contacts the on-call engineer and writes a clear incident note describing the affected equipment. The team never changes a safety threshold without a second reviewer. After inspection, the operator signs the maintenance record and schedules the next verification with the responsible supervisor. These procedures protect both the staff and the equipment during ordinary operation.
